propositions: Core CLI execution must route through the validated registry system with a single authoritative lazy handler resolution instead of parallel explicit intercept/dispatch ladders.
Only the selected handler and parser modules are imported; unrelated handlers and optional stacks remain unimported during command dispatch.
Registry-derived mount, initialization, and confirmation behavior must exactly match the pre-cutover behavioral census, including no-auto-mount cases and conditional selectors.
Handler adapter resolution must use a closed typed set (dispatcher, argv, argv_tracker, argv_tracker_root) and preserve original command remainder argv without re-parsing at the route level.
Bridge compatibility spellings and hidden bridge-status execute through approved adapters while purge-bridge remains unknown.
